# blankcollar.vc

> blankcollar.vc is the pre-seed venture capital arm of The Blank Collar. We back founders building for the AI era with up to CHF 50'000 in capital, the knowledge layer from theblankcollar.com, and a configured, founder-ready agentic OS on blankcollar.ai — capital, knowledge, and automation in one cheque. Switzerland-based, global.

blankcollar.vc is part of The Blank Collar — the post-AI worker practice. "Work is for bots. Life is for humans."
Coined in 2016 and founded in 2018 by Kristian Kabashi (Zürich, Switzerland). The Blank Collar is the
umbrella brand; its ventures are blankcollar.ai (the AI operating system), blankcollar.university (the
school), and blankcollar.vc (pre-seed capital).

## Key facts
- Founder: Kristian Kabashi — https://www.kristiankabashi.com
- Brand: The Blank Collar — https://www.theblankcollar.com
- This venture: blankcollar.vc — pre-seed VC for the AI era, up to CHF 50'000 plus knowledge and an agentic OS — https://www.blankcollar.vc
